jobs.title: Airport Security Specialist
jobs.description:
Menzies Aviation is seeking an Aircraft Security Agent to maintain safety and security at the airport. You will screen passengers and cargo, control access to restricted areas, and actively participate in the Safety Management System.

The role requires alertness, clear communication, and the ability to work in a high-security environment. Qualifications include a high school diploma, background check eligibility (TSA badge), basic computer skills, and the ability to stand for long periods.
